### 4. `docs/build/tools/check_backlog.py` — the missing deterministic half

The contract requires "every OPEN/PARTIAL go-live deferral … in exactly one
BACKLOG source cell (deterministic — `check_backlog.py` enforces this)". The
checker enforced the RISK/ADR/LD universes but not the DEFERRALS→BL mapping.
Added `deferral_homes()`: every OPEN/PARTIAL `D-*` row must name ≥1 `BL-nnn`
(now printed as `deferral homes: 22/22`); a cite-less owed row exits 1.
Guarded by two new tests (`test_deferral_homes_parses_owed_rows`,
`test_every_owed_deferral_cites_a_bl_home` — the latter also asserts every cited
home is a real BL row). The checker is invoked by `make check`
(`test_check_backlog_exits_zero`), so the invariant is CI-enforced.
